body_text:
Slime Time

 DIY Slime. All Vibes. No Clean-Up.

 Book Now

 Quick Details
 📍 Location: 6329 Hwy 57, Jacksonport, WI
⏱ Duration: 20–30 minutes
👶 Ages: 3+ (Kids 10 & under require adult supervision)
🎟 Walk-ins Welcome (Groups of 6+ please call ahead)
💲 Includes: 1 slime base, color, scent (optional), 3 add-ins, take-home jar
🎉 Great For: Rainy days, family fun, birthday parties & private events
🧼 We Provide: Aprons, hand wipes & all supplies — no cleanup for you!

 Slime Time is more than just a craft — it’s a sensory adventure that sparks creativity and pure joy. Kids get to dive hands-first into a world of colors, textures, and sparkly surprises while making something totally their own. It’s a break from screens and structured activities, where imagination runs the show and mess is part of the magic (and none of it happens in your house!).

Parents love Slime Time just as much as the kids do — not only because it’s indoors (perfect for rainy days), but because it’s clean, well-organized, and engaging from start to finish. Our friendly staff keeps things flowing smoothly while letting each child feel like the star of their own slime show. The experience is quick, fun, and leaves families smiling — with a jar of handmade goo to prove it.

Every slime creation is different, and that’s the beauty of it. Whether it’s glittery, crunchy, fluffy, or glow-in-the-dark, your child gets to make something uniquely theirs. We provide high-quality ingredients and a wide range of options so every kid walks out with something they’re proud to squish, stretch, and show off.

Slime Time is a hidden gem in Door County for families looking for creative fun and something to do when the beach is too chilly or the skies open up. Whether you’re a local or just visiting, it’s a one-of-a-kind hands-on experience your kids won’t forget.
